entries.license: Free with a free Adobe ID — no Creative Cloud plan needed. Royalty-free for personal, commercial and non-profit projects; just don't resell or hand out the raw files on their own.
entries.name: Mixamo
entries.what: Free 3D characters and a big animation library — upload your own humanoid character and Mixamo rigs it and animates it for you.

entries.license: CC0 (public domain). Use them anywhere, even in paid work — no credit needed.
entries.name: Kenney
entries.what: Thousands of tidy game assets — 3D models, 2D art, UI pieces and sounds, all in clean matching packs.

entries.license: Free for personal and commercial projects, no credit needed (the pack pages say CC0). Some packs split into a free part and paid tiers, and the license file inside your download is the one that counts — don't resell the packs themselves.
entries.name: Quaternius
entries.what: Chunky low-poly 3D model packs — characters, monsters, villages, sci-fi kits — many rigged and animated.

entries.license: The license changes per model: CC0 (no credit needed) or CC-BY (credit the creator). Both allow commercial use — check the Licence field on the model's page before you download.
entries.name: Poly Pizza
entries.what: A searchable library of 10,000+ low-poly 3D models from lots of creators, with a quick in-browser preview.

entries.license: CC0 (public domain). Copy, change and use them anywhere, even commercially — no credit needed.
entries.name: ambientCG
entries.what: PBR textures, materials and HDRI skies — the stuff that makes 3D scenes and backdrops look real.

entries.license: Free to use — the extension and the channel slots cost nothing. Emotes are shared by the community; an emote's owner can still ask for it to come down.
entries.name: 7TV
entries.what: A huge public emote library for Twitch, Kick and X — everyone gets 1,000 channel emote slots, free.

entries.license: Free and open source. The public emotes are there to be used in chat; a paid Pro tier adds personal perks, but the library itself is free.
entries.name: BetterTTV
entries.what: The classic emote and chat-features extension — browse thousands of shared emotes and add them to your chat.

entries.license: Free to use, public library included. FrankerFaceZ checks submissions, so stolen or commissioned artwork stays out.
entries.name: FrankerFaceZ
entries.what: The original custom-emote platform for Twitch — upload your own or browse the public library, animated emotes included.

entries.license: Free from Nerd Or Die themselves. Some items show a suggested price — enter 0 and they're free, exactly as the page explains.
entries.name: Nerd Or Die
entries.what: Free overlays, alerts, panels and widgets — full packs with setup files for OBS and Streamlabs.

entries.license: Free after a free signup, under OWN3D's commercial license. The hundreds of extra overlays are a paid pass — the free five are genuinely free.
entries.name: OWN3D
entries.what: Five free overlays and alerts through the free OWN3D Pro plugin for OBS, installed in one click.

entries.license: Pixabay Content License: free for commercial and personal use, no credit needed. Don't sell or hand out the unmodified files on their own.
entries.name: Pixabay
entries.what: Photos, videos, music and sound effects — millions of files for BRB screens, alerts and edits.

entries.license: Pexels License: free for personal and commercial use, no credit needed. Don't sell unaltered copies as-is — as stock, a poster or a print.
entries.name: Pexels
entries.what: Free photos and videos with a clean, curated feel — good for backdrops, panels and social posts.

entries.license: There is NO itch.io-wide license: every creator sets their own terms, and some state none. Read the terms on each pack's page before you use it.
entries.name: itch.io game assets
entries.what: Thousands of indie asset packs — sprites, tilesets, 3D models, fonts, sounds — many free or pay-what-you-want.

entries.license: Every item carries its own license — CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, OGA-BY or GPL. Check the license on the item's page; CC-BY means credit the creator.
entries.name: OpenGameArt
entries.what: Community-made art and audio for games and streams, sorted so you can filter by license.

intro: Free stuff other good humans give away — checked by us, explained in plain words. Everything here links OUT to the maker's own site; ForeverHumans doesn't host any of it. Licenses re-checked November 2026 — the page you download from is always the final word.
